title: BluePeak normalized working-capital peg
prompt:
Calculate BluePeak's normalized working-capital peg and closing purchase-price adjustment.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only.

Apply the purchase-agreement definition of operating NWC to BluePeak's twelve monthly balances. Exclude the two documented seasonal-close months, then use the median of the remaining monthly NWC, rather than the average, as the peg. Calculate estimated closing NWC on the same basis, compare it with the peg, and apply the collar and dollar-for-dollar purchase-price adjustment mechanics.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `normalized_nwc_peg`, `estimated_closing_nwc`, `gross_nwc_shortfall`, `collar_absorbed`, `purchase_price_adjustment`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
